notes: ℹ️ Clarified the radar's 'Score 7+' tile. It counts shares whose Watch Score (how strongly a share is accumulating TODAY) is 7 or higher — a different measure from the 🧪 Evidence tiles just below it (🟢 SOLID / ⚡ PN Edge), which grade whether a share's signal has a proven track record. That's why the radar can honestly show '1 Score 7+' and '7 SOLID' at the same time: seven shares carry a proven signal, but only one of them is also accumulating strongly enough today to score 7+. The two tooltips now spell this out so the counts don't read as a contradiction. No numbers changed — both counts were already correct.
